About Us

A Ger Retreat on the Open Steppe

Nestled on Mongolia's open steppe, Talbiun Lodge offers a rare opportunity to experience traditional nomadic hospitality without sacrificing modern comfort. Each ger is handcrafted by local artisans using time-honored techniques.

Our lodge is built on the principles of sustainable tourism and cultural preservation. We work closely with local nomadic families to offer authentic experiences that benefit the community while providing our guests with unforgettable memories.
